description:
Redwood Inference will launch a new Redwood Console "Suggestions" view (beta) focused on cost optimization automation for batching and caching, with clear estimated savings and an explicit risk level to support safe adoption. The primary goal is to reduce time-to-value for Redwood Optimize by turning backend recommendation signals into an actionable, trustworthy UI that customers and internal CS/SE teams can use during onboarding and ongoing optimization.

Scope includes: (1) a Suggestions list + detail drawer that explains the recommendation (what to change, why it helps, where it applies: route/model/region), (2) a standardized savings estimate model (e.g., projected $/1M tokens and monthly impact with confidence intervals), (3) a risk taxonomy (low/medium/high) grounded in potential latency/quality/SLO impact and reversibility, and (4) backend/telemetry contracts so the Console can fetch suggestions, show “basis of estimate”, and track adoption outcomes. Beta will initially be read-only (no one-click apply) behind feature flags with allowlisting; phase 2 adds “apply” workflows once guardrails, rollbacks, and QA coverage are validated.

Key stakeholders: Product (Aditya Rao for Optimize, Marissa Cole for Console & Rollouts), Engineering (Dylan Brooks and Chloe Martin for Console/Tooling, Logan Wright for telemetry/analytics, Ethan Park for control plane integration), Applied ML/Evals (Jonas Weber, Karthik Iyer, Hassan Mirza for risk/savings methodology and validation), and Design (Tessa Morgan with Kenji Nakamura/Alicia Perez for UX). Support/CS are stakeholders for beta onboarding and feedback loops. Target timeline: ~8–10 weeks from kickoff to beta GA to a small cohort: weeks 1–2 discovery + PRD + UX, weeks 3–6 implementation (data contract, APIs, UI), weeks 7–8 validation (accuracy, guardrails, QA, telemetry), weeks 9–10 beta rollout + feedback + iteration. Constraints: accuracy and explainability of savings estimates, avoiding recommendation-induced regressions (latency/quality), respecting customer isolation/privacy, and keeping the UI consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.

files.description: PRD for the Suggestions Console UX beta: problem statement, user personas (ML/platform engineers, CS/SE), goals/non-goals, success metrics, beta cohort plan, and phased rollout (read-only -> apply).

UX spec for the Suggestions view: IA, list/filtering (route/model/region), detail drawer content, risk/savings disclosure patterns, empty states, and copy guidelines for "estimated" vs "guaranteed" savings.
ADR defining the risk level framework (low/medium/high): inputs (latency headroom, cache hit-rate confidence, workload variance), thresholds, and how risk is presented and audited.
ADR for the standardized savings estimate model: required fields, confidence scoring, baselines, how to avoid double-counting (batching vs caching), and versioning strategy.
Service overview for the backend powering Suggestions: ownership, endpoints, data sources, caching strategy, multi-tenant isolation, and failure modes (stale estimates, missing telemetry).
How-to for enabling the Suggestions beta per account/workspace: allowlist workflow, feature flag configuration, verification steps in staging/prod, and rollback.
Quality guardrails doc: which recommendations are suppressed, how regression signals are computed, required eval coverage, and alerting/auto-disable criteria for beta.
Evaluation plan for validating batching/caching suggestions: prompt sets, workload slices, acceptance thresholds (quality deltas, latency p95), and reporting cadence.
Internal docs draft for the Console docs site: what Suggestions are, interpreting risk/savings, limitations of beta, and troubleshooting (why no suggestions appear).
Security review checklist and findings: data exposure considerations (cost/usage), RBAC scoping for viewing suggestions, audit logging requirements, and any mitigations.
Working doc defining beta KPIs (adoption, estimated vs realized savings, user trust signals), plus notes/links to dashboards and open measurement questions.
Sheet-style doc listing target beta customers, account context, primary use case, owner (AE/SE/CSM), enablement status, and feedback notes.
Launch brief draft for internal stakeholders: messaging, enablement steps, support readiness, known limitations, and weekly check-in agenda.
Engineering scratchpad for UI build: component breakdown, routing, query states, pagination/filtering decisions, and TODOs from design review.
Draft API contract between Console and Optimize suggestions service: JSON schema, field semantics, and example payloads for savings + risk explanations.
Notes from telemetry validation: mismatches between token metering and UI estimates, suspected causes, proposed fixes, and test queries.
Applied ML working notes on prototype risk scoring: feature candidates, calibration ideas, offline evaluation results, and gaps.
Operational checklist for beta rollout: flags, allowlist, migrations, monitoring, alert thresholds, and comms coordination with Support.
SRE readiness notes: expected failure modes, runbook links, dashboards to watch, and criteria for pausing beta.
Copy exploration doc for disclaimers and user-facing explanations of savings and risk; includes variants for enterprise vs self-serve contexts.
Top-level PM ticket to run the "Optimization suggestions Console UX (beta)" initiative: milestones, beta cohort definition, and success metrics.
Design ticket: Suggestions list + detail drawer UX, including filters, comparison views, and risk/savings disclosure patterns.
Design ticket: information architecture and nav placement (where Suggestions lives in Console), plus empty states and onboarding tooltip flows.
Engineering epic: implement Suggestions view end-to-end (backend endpoints + Console UI), with acceptance criteria and rollout plan.
Backend ticket: create suggestions-service read API (list + detail), with pagination, filtering, and tenant scoping.
Telemetry ticket: define and compute baseline cost metrics required for savings estimates (per route/model) and ensure freshness SLOs.
Console ticket: implement Suggestions UI components, data fetching, loading/error states, and feature-flag gating.
Applied ML ticket (engineering-owned integration): implement risk level computation pipeline and store explanations used by the UI.
QA ticket: end-to-end automated tests for Suggestions pages (role-based access, allowlist gating, schema validation, regressions).
Reliability ticket: add dashboards/alerts for suggestions-service latency/error rate and stale estimate detection.
Platform ticket: RBAC and audit logging for viewing suggestions (who accessed, what tenant, what recommendation IDs).
Experimentation ticket: capture "suggestion viewed" and "suggestion adopted" events and tie to realized savings measurement.
PM ticket: beta enablement plan + support readiness (FAQ, escalation path, weekly feedback cadence, and exit criteria for beta).
Engineering ticket: add versioned schema for savings estimate payloads and backwards-compatible UI rendering.
